description.value: Camy's Pizza has operated in Surrey since 1985 and claims to be the originator of the butter chicken pizza. Located in Townline Plaza (Cedar Hill), it offers an unusually broad menu spanning specialty pizzas, Indian cuisine, Greek dishes, pasta, calzones, and wings, all made to order. Both pickup and delivery are available, making it a practical food stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active pizza restaurant at 12849 96 Avenue, Surrey, with recent reviews dated May 2026. The site explicitly mentions pickup/delivery and vegetarian menu options; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. The website lists two phone numbers (604-589-9559 and 604-581-5555) while OSM only records the first one.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (604-581-5555) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is clearly active and offers takeout with vegetarian options useful to cyclists, but no evidence of bike parking (a required WWC criterion) or other cycling-specific amenities could be found on the website or in OSM tags.
